declarations.state_ownership: Owns pod_order_inbox (migration 0093:18-29), keyed by woo_order_id, service-role-only RLS (0093:35-39); organization_id is nullable with ON DELETE SET NULL and written as null today (0093:11, app/api/webhooks/woo-order/route.ts:82-85). Generated files go to the customer's R2 designs bucket through putDesignObject (lib/studio/print-file.ts:178, upscaler.ts:191, wp-web-image.ts:126, printful-mockup.ts:272). Mockup presets (0045) belong to design, not studio.
declarations.behavior_ownership: AI image generation, background removal, inpaint, generative fill, mockups, culture and trending ideas and edit prompts (app/api/tools/studio/*); print files and PDF/X (lib/studio/print-file.ts, ghostscript-pdfx.ts); the Printful catalog, sync and mockups (print-provider.ts, printful-catalog.ts, printful-mockup.ts); paid Woo order -> Printful DRAFT order through the durable inbox (pod-order-inbox.ts:1-13, woo-order/route.ts). Product copy and upscale are library functions used by the shared /api/tools/publish route (app/api/tools/publish/route.ts:4, :9).
declarations.public_api_event_contract: HTTP /api/tools/studio/{culture, edit-prompt, generate, genfill, inpaint, mockup, proxy-image, remove-bg, trending}; POST /api/webhooks/woo-order with HMAC x-wc-webhook-signature (woo-order/route.ts:43-45, lib/studio/woo-webhook.ts:39); POST /api/internal/pod-orders/sweep and GET /api/internal/pod-orders/stats with Bearer POD_INBOX_SWEEP_TOKEN (lib/studio/pod-inbox-auth.ts:5-10), the sweep called every 10 minutes by the Trigger task pod-order-inbox-sweep (packages/workflows/src/trigger/pod-order-inbox-sweep.ts:32-34). Outbound: Printful https://api.printful.com (print-provider.ts:19), Replicate, Anthropic / OpenAI (image-edit-prompt.ts:106, :133), R2.
declarations.invariants: Printful orders are DRAFT only: POST /orders never carries confirm, so nothing is charged or printed (print-provider.ts:465-470). Every inbox state change is conditional on (status, attempts), so two workers cannot both call Printful for one order (pod-order-inbox.ts:8-10, :100-111); at most 5 attempts with 5/10/20/40-minute backoff, a stale claim is reclaimable after 15 minutes (pod-order-inbox.ts:21-24). A redelivery never resets status (pod-order-inbox.ts:63-67). Kill switches default off: POD_AUTO_FULFILL_ENABLED !== "true" keeps the webhook dormant (woo-order/route.ts:39) and POD_DESIGNS_ENABLED !== "true" answers 503 on the studio routes (app/api/tools/studio/generate/route.ts:49). Paid calls need studio.* grants (lib/studio/bg-remover.ts:36, inpaint.ts:44, upscaler.ts:83).
declarations.dependencies: supabase (pod_order_inbox), trigger (pod-order-inbox-sweep), R2 designs bucket, Printful, Replicate, Anthropic, OpenAI, WooCommerce webhooks, wp-bridge through the shared publish route (WPBRIDGE_*, app/api/tools/publish/route.ts:351), the system-modes gate (pod-order-inbox.ts:16, :126). The image engine is lib/tarot/image-gen.ts in the same app, reached through lib/studio/image-provider.ts:1-13; products.ts dependsOn is empty. Inventory: ADR 017 section 5 row studio.
declarations.failure_isolation_boundary: The Woo webhook answers 2xx once the order is recorded; only a failed inbox write returns 5xx (woo-order/route.ts:20-25, :86-88). A paid order that cannot be parsed is kept as failed without retries for manual forwarding (pod-order-inbox.ts:87-99). A blocked system mode defers the row and the drain stops at the first deferral (pod-order-inbox.ts:126-131, :158-160); the drain never throws (:161-186). The sweep task makes one attempt per tick and skips when its token is unset (pod-order-inbox-sweep.ts:35-41).
declarations.data_lifecycle: pod_order_inbox rows are never deleted by code; done rows keep done_at (pod-order-inbox.ts:81); deleting an organization sets organization_id null (0093:20). R2 objects written by studio are not deleted by studio code (deleteDesignObject is defined at lib/storage/r2.ts:253 and not called from lib/studio); designs saved to the gallery are deleted through design's /api/tools/designs.
declarations.observability_contract: GET /api/internal/pod-orders/stats returns deferred, oldest deferred age, retrying, overdue retries, gave-up, stuck pending and capped counts, and ok:false rather than zeros when the table is unreadable (pod-order-inbox.ts:213-249); the AO smoke check reads it (app/api/internal/pod-orders/stats/route.ts:1-4). Image cost is logged per route with logImageCost (generate/route.ts:126, remove-bg/route.ts:43, mockup/route.ts:121). Inbox failures are written to console.error (pod-order-inbox.ts:81, :109, :171).
declarations.migration_rollback_contract: 0093 has lobster-factory/packages/db/scripts/0093_pod_order_inbox_down.sql, which refuses while any order is pending, deferred or failed and removes the 0093 ledger row (header :1-4); it is run by hand.
declarations.replacement_strategy: Printful sits behind a provider-neutral seam (print-provider.ts:1-2); image generation behind lib/studio/image-provider.ts so the engine can move without touching studio callers (:1-7); WooCommerce parsing and signature checks are isolated in lib/studio/woo-webhook.ts.

Optional model pins BG_REMOVER_VERSION, GENFILL_VERSION, INPAINT_VERSION, REALESRGAN_VERSION, ANTHROPIC_MODEL.
configuration.generatedByInstall: POD_INBOX_SWEEP_TOKEN (lib/studio/pod-inbox-auth.ts:6; the Trigger worker reads the same value), AWAREWAVE_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL on the Trigger worker (pod-order-inbox-sweep.ts:21)
configuration.switches: POD_DESIGNS_ENABLED=true enables the studio routes; POD_AUTO_FULFILL_ENABLED=true enables Woo -> Printful draft orders (woo-order/route.ts:39); POD_OUTPUT_INTENT_DEPLOYED and POD_ICC_* for PDF/X output (lib/studio/ghostscript-pdfx.ts:44, :63)
configuration.installUnit: Each services entry names the service this product calls; the installer installs that entry's whole compose file (ADR 017 section 5 inventory).
